fukuoka.name: Fukuoka Campus
fukuoka.atmosphere: Located in historic Dazaifu, close to Fukuoka city center. Large campus with a traditional academic atmosphere.

shibuya.name: Tokyo Shibuya Campus
shibuya.atmosphere: In the heart of Tokyo's trends and business. Focused on management and creative/digital courses.

kobe.name: Kobe Sannomiya Campus
kobe.atmosphere: Located in the international city of Kobe, focusing on global economics.

programs.economics: Fukuoka and Kobe campuses offering Economics and Global Economics.
programs.management: Fukuoka and Shibuya campuses focusing on modern business, venture, e-sports, and digital business.

special_courses.name: eSports Course
special_courses.description: Collaboration with Sengoku Gaming. Focuses on eSports business and management.

special_courses.name: Game/Animation Course
special_courses.description: Creative business focus at Shibuya Campus.

admissions.requirements: 12 years of education, JLPT N2 recommended, interview and document review.

support.center: International Exchange Center handles visas, scholarships, and life support.
support.dorms: Dormitories available at all campuses (Tsuzuki, Gojoyama, Shibuya Residence, Sannomiya Dorm).
